column1: # lane-table.tsv (integrator-5, 2026-10-17; team-lead hold leg (b)): ONE table of the required hosted lanes. Columns, tab-separated:
# v2 (team-lead H2 2026-10-23): the ci pin is a TEXT anchor, file@job=exact trimmed text, found in that job (lane-forms-leg v8).
# id | ci job | env (K=V;K=V or -) | owning classifier sets (comma; "vitest:list" = vitest's own list in web/) | mode (perfile|whole) | cwd (root|web) |
# command ({f} repo path, {rel} path relative to cwd, {covdir} a leg-private dir) | script pin (file:line=exact trimmed text) | ci pin (file:line=text) |
# podman (yes = the lane installs the extension runner, ci.yml setup-extension-runner-ci.sh --install, or runs on a self-hosted runner with
# Podman: run only in the heavy lock, Podman present)
# v7 (team-lead's ruling a8b7283108caee00): owner kinds "lane:<job>" (the product's lane manifest, scripts/check-factory-lanes.ts) and
# "workflow:<path>" (the ONE reader w00/ci-workflow-steps.ts); mode "step" runs each owning step's own run with its workflow+job+step env
# (command "{step}", env "-"); env value "{pg}" = the hold's own PostgreSQL, "{covdir}" = the leg-private dir.
